description:
Start an instance

Starts a machine for one model: gpuClass (default h200) and size (eighths of a node, default 1) pick its spec and price, fixed for as long as it runs. Billing is per second while it runs, one minute at least: the first minute is debited at once. From the next call on (within a few seconds), the account's calls to that model through any of its model keys cost nothing per token and are held to the machine's limits instead (429 with Retry-After past one). It runs until stopped (stop_instance), until its hours pass, or until the balance runs out. One running instance per model: a second start of the same model is a 409 conflict naming the running one. 402 insufficient_balance when the balance does not cover the first minute; 503 not_configured while no price is known for the model.

gpuClass.description: The node class the machine is sized like: one the model is offered on (its machines in list_instance_types). Absent: the model's own class.

hours.description: How long it runs, in hours from now (0.25 is 15 minutes, 2 is two hours); it stops by itself then. Null or absent: it runs until you stop it or the balance runs out. Billing is per second either way.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique string so that repeating this call never creates twice.

instanceName.description: Your name for it, shown in the console's history and the API.

size.description: Eighths of a node: 1 is 1/8 node, 2 a quarter, 4 a half, 8 a full node.

name: start_instance
title: Start an instance
